measurement_provenance.measured_kv_pool_note: KV_POOL_SIZE was unset, so the daemon auto-sized the pool to global_bytes=16,700,672,000 (36,650 page groups; cache_bytes=16,745,176,576, about 16.7 GB) with device_occupied_bytes=99,091,742,720 of device_budget_bytes=101,973,491,712.
measurement_provenance.note: The KV pool was pinned to 12GiB in a057296 (12,884,807,680 B of pool; 28,276 whole 455,680-byte page groups) to return roughly 3.8 GB of device headroom. Later profile edits (through 9287203) are comment-only and keep the pin. The pinned profile has not been remeasured, so every measured number in this report belongs to the pre-pin profile.

limitations.summary: Every performance number was measured on the config before the KV_POOL_SIZE pin and does not describe the current published profile.
limitations.detail: The measured profile left KV_POOL_SIZE unset; the daemon auto policy filled the device to global_bytes=16,700,672,000 (36,650 page groups; cache_bytes=16,745,176,576, about 16.7 GB). The pin was introduced at commit a057296 and stands at the current published profile commit 9287203: KV_POOL_SIZE=12GiB (12,884,807,680 B of pool; 28,276 groups; config sha256 f682aa1f4d282a7ab05c127460dc9244b5aec0d1ec8d870bfdad5c9180be7af9). The pinned profile has NOT been remeasured, so these numbers are informational for the pre-pin config only.
limitations.affects: all measured throughput, memory and tool-eval numbers in this report

limitations.summary: The retained gate expectation was corrected after the run (2f8208b); the recorded retained non-pass cells are retained as raw and not retroactively rewritten.
limitations.detail: The two retained non-pass records (contexts 65536 and 262144, case code-reasoning, repeat 1) were produced under the pre-2f8208b strict full-parent-turn-reuse expectation. Commit 2f8208b corrected the harness gate to accept prompt-prefix reuse (context <= prompt_cache_hit_tokens <= parent turn frontier with self-consistent accounting) and to record full generated-turn reuse separately. Under the corrected contract those cells are understood as prompt-prefix reuse successes, but the raw records, the recorded failure verdict and the strict record-accounting outcome are left exactly as measured.

limitations.summary: Tool-eval is 88 / 264 scenario-runs; runs 2-3 did not start (OOM capacity-gated) under the pre-pin auto KV pool.
limitations.detail: Run 1 completed 88 scenario-runs (131/144 points; 18 fail / 9 partial / 61 pass). Runs 2-3 failed request admission with cudaGraphInstantiate / cudaMalloc 'out of memory' at --parallel 16 under the auto-sized pool. The a057296 pin targets that headroom but has not been remeasured.

limitations.summary: This is an incomplete, informational performance report, not a formal release qualification.
